data.title: Binghatti Ivory
data.about:
Introducing the Binghatti Ivory Project, a striking architectural masterpiece by Binghatti Developers situated in the vibrant Al Jaddaf community of Dubai. The 25-storey residential tower, featuring 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, will be located in Healthcare City Phase 2, Al Jaddaf, Dubai.

Binghatti Ivory’s contemporary design seamlessly blends luxury, natural elements, and sophisticated finishes. Residents can enjoy an array of premium features, including expansive windows that flood the interiors with natural light and private balconies. Whether spending evenings with loved ones in the communal areas or admiring the breathtaking river views from their balcony, homeowners will find Binghatti Ivory Apartments at Al Jaddaf Dubai offers an unparalleled living experience.

characteristics_module.title: Experience Luxurious Living at Binghatti Ivory Residences
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime Location in Healthcare City Phase 2: Situated in the vibrant Al Jaddaf area, providing easy access to top healthcare facilities, business hubs, and key areas of Dubai.
  • Architectural Excellence: A striking 25-storey residential tower by Binghatti Developers, featuring a modern design that blends luxury with natural elements and unique twisted balconies.
  • Expansive Natural Light: Large windows in every unit maximize natural light, creating bright and airy living spaces that enhance comfort and well-being.
  • Exclusive Amenities: Residents can enjoy premium communal areas, perfect for gatherings with family and friends, as well as stunning river views from private balconies.
  • Ample Parking: Two basement levels of parking ensure convenience and security for all residents, a significant benefit in a bustling area like Al Jaddaf.
  • Proximity to Major Landmarks: Located close to Dubai Creek and key business districts, making it a highly sought-after destination for modern living.

location_tile.title: Al Jaddaf Community Features Excellent Amenities
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Located in Healthcare City Phase 2, Al Jaddaf, Binghatti Ivory Residences offers residents a strategic address in one of Dubai’s most dynamic and well-connected areas. The thriving community is known for its close proximity to top healthcare institutions, making it a key hub for wellness and medical innovation. Moreover, with easy access to Dubai Creek, major highways, and nearby business and leisure districts, residents can enjoy both the convenience of city living and the serenity of a riverside lifestyle, all within minutes of Dubai’s key attractions.

  • Dubai Creek Harbour – 5 minutes
  • Dubai Healthcare City – 5 minutes
  • Downtown Dubai (Burj Khalifa & Dubai Mall) – 10 minutes
  • Dubai International Airport (DXB) – 10 minutes
  • Business Bay – 10 minutes
